Before & after

What actually changes for your HR team

BEFORE

The old way

HR data is among the most sensitive in any organization — and yet often lives in shared drives with no meaningful access controls.

  • Spreadsheets & paper forms
  • Manual re-keying between systems
  • The same HR questions, every day
Switch to SublimeHR
SublimeHR● Live

Role-based access, feature-level permissions, MFA, tenant isolation, and full audit trails — configured in minutes, not months.

  • Meet enterprise security requirements out of the box
  • Isolate data per tenant, branch and department
  • Track every policy and status change automatically

Everything included

12 capabilities, ready on day one

Configured to your policies — no code, no add-ons.

  • Role-based permissions (View / Add / Edit / Delete)
  • Feature-level access control
  • User-level permission overrides
  • MFA / OTP authentication
  • Login by email, username or employee code
  • Tenant & subdomain isolation
  • Dual-panel access for HR staff
  • Profile & password policies
  • Audit trail on policy & status changes
  • Branch-level settings
  • Custom company branding & themes
  • English & Arabic language support

Quick answers

Security & Access Control, answered.

Yes. SublimeHR runs on secure cloud infrastructure with encrypted connections, MFA, role-based access and tenant isolation.
Yes. MFA / OTP authentication can be enforced for users.
Roles carry View / Add / Edit / Delete rights per feature, with user-level overrides when someone needs an exception.
Yes. Changes to policies, statuses and other critical records are logged with who changed what and when.
Yes. Multi-tenant architecture with subdomain isolation keeps each customer's data logically separated.
SublimeHR is a cloud-based HR and workforce management platform. It brings employee records, attendance, leave, shift scheduling, payroll, reports and employee self-service into one system, with separate Admin and Employee panels and a native mobile app.
Growing businesses and enterprises across manufacturing, healthcare, IT, education, hospitality, retail, logistics, professional services and construction — anywhere you manage office, remote, hybrid, shift-based or field teams.
Most customers go live in days, not months. Our team handles setup and data migration, then trains your admins and employees.
